limitations.note: Both square-wave comparisons still use 20 instead of 19, leaving a 21-clock period with one extra high sample.
The triangle rewrite changes reset and mode-entry behavior: the first triangle sample after reset is 1 instead of the 31 produced by the original direction logic that the reference keeps.
The test encoded the defective 21-clock square period and the rewritten triangle’s immediate ascent as expected behavior, so it passed despite both mismatches.
